description: 8 retrieval probes for colinhacks/zod — an MIT-licensed types-heavy TypeScript schema validation library with conditional types, mapped types, function overloads, and zero JSX (distinct from the existing vercel/ai-chatbot TS pack which is JSX-heavy).

probes.query: how does zod validate a value against a schema and return success or issues
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: safeParse (line 73) is the never-throw validation entry — returns { success, data, error } discriminated union

probes.query: how does zod format validation errors into a structured tree with paths
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: treeifyError (line 345) groups issues by their path into a nested tree

probes.query: how does zod convert a schema definition into a JSON Schema document
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: toJSONSchema is the JSON Schema export path; key for OpenAPI integrations
Symbol-anchored probe: $ZodType (schemas.ts:179) is the structural interface every schema implements

probes.query: zod safeParse function with discriminated union return type
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: _safeParse (parse.ts:59) is the curried factory underlying the public safeParse

probes.query: zod $ZodTypeInternals interface with input output type parameters
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: $ZodTypeInternals (schemas.ts:168) is `interface $ZodTypeInternals<out O = unknown, out I = unknown>` — the inner type-state holding input/output generics

probes.query: zod flattenError function with overloaded signatures and optional mapper
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: flattenError has 3 declarations on lines 263/264/265: two `export function ... : <returntype>;` overload stubs and the concrete implementation. Exercises tree-sitter-typescript's parsing of function overload signatures followed by the implementation — chunker should attribute all to the same `flattenError` symbol

probes.query: zod $ZodType interface with variance annotation on type parameters
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: $ZodType / $ZodTypeInternals (schemas.ts:168, 179) use TypeScript variance modifiers `out O = unknown, out I = unknown` on type parameters — a TS 4.7+ feature. Exercises tree-sitter-typescript's handling of `out` / `in` annotations on generic parameter declarations
